title: Example function is reporting invocation errors

entry.query: fields @timestamp, @message, level | filter level = 'ERROR' | sort @timestamp desc

cases.description: the function exhausted its configured memory
cases.prose: The function ran out of memory. The runbook's recorded action is to raise the memory ceiling for the next release.
cases.resolution: Raise the configured memory ceiling; tracked against the owning team.

cases.prose: A downstream call was throttled. This clears on the built-in retry.
cases.resolution: No action while the retry succeeds.

followUps: Confirm the function's error-rate metric returned to baseline.
